summary: Iteration 10 — FRONTEND-ONLY QA of the Staff Workspace + Operations Intelligence redesign on the public preview URL (staff cookie session_token=test_session_step2_demo, plus demo-viewer flow). No backend/API suites re-run per request. SIDEBAR: all 10 testids present and visible with correct group headers WORKSPACE/ISSUES/OPERATIONS and count badges (Needs Attention 11, Review 11, Action 5, AI Resolved 5, Failed Resolutions 3, All Issues 21); every ISSUES item navigates to /staff?view=needs|review|action|resolved|failed|all, highlights the active item (bg-brand-50), hides metrics-row and renders the filtered table with correct row counts (11/11/5/5/3/21) plus a working dashboard-search (typing '603' filtered 21 -> 1). Deep link /staff?view=all loads directly with the right active nav + 21 rows. OVERVIEW: renders in order shared-incident-banner -> impact-strip (48% / 1.3h / 100% / 3 / 3) -> single compact metrics-row (16 Interactions, 5 AI Resolved, 5 Actions, 11 Reviews, 3 Failed, 2m Median Response) -> 'Needs Your Attention' (6 cards) with a 'View all' link; no pill tab row and no issues table (dashboard-search count 0) as intended. reset-demo-btn (toast + reload, seed intact at 21 issues), refresh-btn and run-demo-btn (-> /staff/demo 'See CloseLoop in 2 minutes') all work. Clicking an attention card opens the Issue Detail sheet; Unit 603 (from Failed Resolutions view) shows the red failed-resolution-banner with attempts/contacts/original report and REPEAT COMPLAINT block. OPERATIONS INTELLIGENCE (/staff/insights): title 'Operations Intelligence', DEMO ENVIRONMENT badge, all 7 panels render with real aggregated data (kpi-strip 3 repeat / 3 failed / 1.3 avg attempts / Maintenance / Unit 118 / 1m median), recharts SVG renders, All/Repeat/Failed/Reviews chips toggle series without errors, range-7d/30d/90d/all all clickable with no errors, hotspot row -> /staff?view=all, category bar -> /staff?view=all, repeat-failed row -> /staff?view=failed. REGRESSION: /staff/knowledge ('Property Knowledge'), /staff/leads ('Demo Requests' with 1 lead row), /staff/demo overlay, /portal (submitted TEST_QA Rider/TEST999 -> AI triage card 'We've got it. Amenity P3 Admin'; My Requests tab tracked the request with status badge) all pass. Demo login via 'View Demo Dashboard' lands read-only on /staff with demo-viewer-badge and NO nav-demo-requests; demo user can browse All Issues (21) and Analytics. Zero pageerrors/console errors on all tested routes after the fix below (only benign /api/auth/me 401 before session hydration). TEST DATA CLEANED: TEST999 issue + interaction deleted; DB back to 21 issues / 50 interactions / 603 reopened+failed_resolution.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: clicking 'View all' next to 'Needs Your Attention' threw an uncaught ReferenceError 'navigate is not defined' and did not navigate — the StaffDashboard component used navigate() at line ~308 but useNavigate() was only declared inside the ImpactStrip sub-component. Added `const navigate = useNavigate();` to StaffDashboard; re-verified it now routes to /staff?view=needs with no errors.

At mobile width (390px) the whole sidebar is `hidden md:flex`, so there is NO navigation at all and no Sign Out button. Since the old pill tab row was removed, mobile/tablet-portrait staff cannot reach Needs Attention/Review/Action/Failed/All Issues/Knowledge/Analytics/Demo Requests or log out. Needs a hamburger/drawer or a mobile nav row.

At 390px the header action buttons (Reset Demo Data / Run Demo / Refresh) wrap and overlap/crowd the h1 title ('Good morning' is squeezed into two lines behind the buttons) because the header is a fixed h-16 flex row with no wrapping/stacking rules.

issues: Y-axis tick labels are clipped: AreaChart margin left:-18 with YAxis width 34 cuts the first character of 2-digit values ('16' renders as '6', '12' as '2'). Reduce the negative left margin or widen the YAxis.

Header title uses the raw internal tab key instead of the sidebar label: 'Needs' (should be 'Needs Attention'), 'REVIEW'/'ACTION' in all-caps lane style vs Title Case 'AI Resolved'/'Failed Resolutions'/'All Issues'. Inconsistent casing/labels between sidebar and page header.
The 'Possible Shared Incident' violet banner also renders above every issue sub-view table (not just Overview), pushing the search box down; spec placed it in the Overview stack only. Low severity.
Demo overlay header logo mark renders in near-black while every other surface uses the brand-700 deep-blue mark — minor inconsistency vs the 'one consistent logo' requirement.

Not a bug, but note: 7d/30d/90d/All produce identical output because all 21 seeded issues were created within the last ~3 days, so the range toggle appears to do nothing. Consider spreading seed created_at over ~60 days so the toggle is demonstrable.

action_items: Add a mobile navigation affordance (hamburger/drawer or horizontal nav) for StaffLayout below md — currently no nav and no Sign Out on mobile.
Make the staff header responsive (allow wrap / h-auto / hide labels) so action buttons don't collide with the page title at small widths.
Fix clipped Y-axis labels in the Issue Trend chart (AreaChart margin left -18 / YAxis width 34).
Use the sidebar labels for sub-view page titles ('Needs Attention', 'Review', 'Action') instead of raw tab keys 'Needs'/'REVIEW'/'ACTION'.
Optionally scope the shared-incident banner to the Overview tab only, and re-check the demo-overlay logo color for brand consistency.
Review the tester fix in StaffDashboard.jsx (added missing useNavigate) — keep it.
critical_code_review_comments: StaffDashboard.jsx had a hook-scope bug (navigate used in the parent component but declared only in ImpactStrip) that shipped an uncaught runtime error on a primary CTA — such cross-component identifier reuse should be caught by lint (no-undef is clearly not failing the build).

StaffLayout.jsx recomputes the sidebar counts client-side from GET /issues once on mount and never refetches; badges go stale after Reset Demo Data / status changes (counts only refresh on a full page reload). Consider lifting the issues fetch or exposing a refresh callback.

The repeat/failed predicate `failed_resolution || resolution_attempts>0 || status==='reopened'` is duplicated in StaffLayout.jsx, StaffDashboard.jsx and TrendInsights.jsx — extract to a shared helper to avoid drift.
TrendInsights.jsx Panel heading has conflicting Tailwind classes (`tracking-tight tracking-widest` on the same h2).
Hotspot-unit, category and repeat-failed row clicks all navigate to a generic /staff?view=all|failed with no unit/category prefilter (search query is not seeded), so the drill-down loses context.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all redesign flows pass after the 1 tester-applied fix; 2 responsive/mobile gaps + 4 cosmetic issues open)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one throwaway resident request (TEST_QA Rider / Unit TEST999) to regression-test /portal submit+track. DB restored: 21 issues, 50 interactions, Unit 603 = reopened + failed_resolution + 1 attempt. Reset Demo Data was also exercised once and completed successfully.
test_credentials: Staff: cookie session_token=test_session_step2_demo (domain triage-skeleton.preview.emergentagent.com, secure, sameSite=None). Demo viewer: click 'View Demo Dashboard' on /staff/login (POST /api/auth/demo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright: inject the staff cookie via page.context.add_cookies BEFORE goto, then wait ~2.5s for /api/auth/me hydration (a 401 console entry before hydration is expected and benign). Sidebar testids are derived from labels: nav-overview, nav-needs-attention, nav-review, nav-action, nav-ai-resolved, nav-failed-resolutions, nav-all-issues, nav-knowledge-base, nav-analytics, nav-demo-requests. Active state = class contains 'bg-brand-50'. Issue rows: [data-testid^='issue-row-']; Overview cards: [data-testid^='attention-card-']. Portal submit testid is submit-issue-btn (not submit-request-btn) and track uses tab-track-request + resident-name-input/resident-unit-input + track-requests-btn. Insights panels: kpi-strip, trend-panel, category-panel, quality-panel, hotspots-panel, attention-panel, repeat-failed-panel; ranges range-7d/30d/90d/all. Avoid f-strings containing backslashes in the automation tool script. Always clean up any created issues from db.issues/db.interactions afterwards.
rca_of_the_issue: Overview 'View all' crash: StaffDashboard.jsx declared `const navigate = useNavigate()` only inside the ImpactStrip helper component (line 82); the exported StaffDashboard component referenced `navigate('/staff?view=needs')` in the 'View all' onClick, so React threw 'navigate is not defined' at click time and the navigation silently failed. Fixed by declaring useNavigate() inside StaffDashboard and re-verified end to end.
